evaluator: Senior ML Research Lead & Skeptical Clinical AI Auditor

system_state.codebase_status: Working prototype with unit tests and synthetic benchmark suite

static_ehr_integration.current_implementation: Static JSON metadata in data/synthetic_demo/patients.json containing patient_id, label, condition, median glucose, and text notes. Rendered purely in UI sidebar.
static_ehr_integration.gap: Zero static EHR features are ingested into windows_all.parquet, build_features.py, or model feature matrix X (X dimension = 43, 100% CGM-derived). Patient ID is explicitly excluded to prevent patient overfitting.
static_ehr_integration.required_remediation: Incorporate structured historical EHR baseline parameters (e.g. baseline HbA1c proxy, diabetes duration, insulin sensitivity factor, mean nocturnal baseline) into the two-stream feature fusion pipeline.

dynamic_wearable_integration.current_implementation: Only CGM (glucose_mgdl) is generated and ingested. Synthetic CSV contains sparse/empty meal_carbs_g which is ignored in window extraction.
dynamic_wearable_integration.gap: No physical wearable channels exist (Heart Rate, Heart Rate Variability, Step Count, Accelerometry, Skin Temperature, Sleep Stage).
dynamic_wearable_integration.required_remediation: Must clearly define the dynamic wearable scope: either incorporate multi-sensor wearable streams (HR/steps) or explicitly formalize the dynamic stream as CGM-centric wearable biosensing with rigorous ablation.

multimodal_two_stream_fusion.current_implementation: Model is a single-stream autoregressive tabular gradient booster (HistGradientBoostingRegressor).
multimodal_two_stream_fusion.gap: No fusion layer exists between static EHR and dynamic time-series. The model cannot prove that adding static EHR improves forecasting over CGM alone.
multimodal_two_stream_fusion.required_remediation: Construct a controlled multi-stream ablation experiment (Prompt 1) comparing: (1) CGM history only, (2) CGM + static patient context, (3) CGM + dynamic context, (4) Joint Two-Stream Fusion.

localized_adverse_event_target.current_implementation: Point regression predicting continuous blood glucose at t+120 minutes (y in mg/dL).
localized_adverse_event_target.gap: Continuous glucose regression does not explicitly score or classify acute localized clinical events (e.g. Hypoglycemia <70 mg/dL, Severe Hypoglycemia <54 mg/dL, Hyperglycemia >180 mg/dL). Classification metrics (AUROC, AUPRC, Sensitivity/Specificity at frozen clinical cutoffs) are missing.
localized_adverse_event_target.required_remediation: Define dual target outputs: (a) continuous point trajectory at t+120m, (b) binary/multiclass adverse excursion event detector with fixed clinical thresholds and calibrated event probabilities.

digital_twin_drift_detection.current_implementation: Rule-based input data quality checker (ReliabilityChecker) detecting sensor failures (stale readings, gaps, bounds).
digital_twin_drift_detection.gap: Input validation checks sensor corruption, not physiological twin drift. A patient can have clean sensor data while their physiological state (metabolic resistance, illness, acute stress) diverges drastically from the twin model's internal representation.
digital_twin_drift_detection.required_remediation: Formalize the Twin State and construct an explicit Twin Drift Detection engine (monitoring cumulative prediction residual divergence, Kalman/particle innovation, or distribution shift) that triggers 'Twin Drift Warning' and degrades confidence.

reliability_and_gating.current_implementation: 6 machine-readable reason codes (OK_DATA_INTACT, WARN_PARTIAL_SEQUENCE, ERR_STALE_READING, ERR_EXCESSIVE_GAP, ERR_PHYSIOLOGICAL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, ERR_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY) mapped to 3 operational statuses (AVAILABLE, DEGRADED, WITHHELD). Zero silent fabrication.
reliability_and_gating.gap: Thresholds (20m stale, 30m gap) are engineering heuristics rather than empirically optimized clinical boundaries.
reliability_and_gating.required_remediation: Quantify selective prediction curves (MAE vs coverage) under progressive fault injection.

leakage_prevention.current_implementation: Strict chronological 65/15/20 split across time with 120-minute exclusion buffer between splits. Zero future information used in feature extraction. Scalers and feature stats fitted only on train split.
leakage_prevention.gap: None identified computationally. Fully audited in docs/leakage_audit.md.
leakage_prevention.required_remediation: Maintain strict preservation of splitting protocols.

experimental_reproducibility.current_implementation: Deterministic scripts (scripts/reproduce_results.py, scripts/build_dataset.py) replicating exact numbers across platforms. Fixed seeds (SEED=42).
experimental_reproducibility.gap: Depends on local synthetic data generator.
experimental_reproducibility.required_remediation: Retain automated verification script in CI/test suite.

external_validity_and_generalizability.current_implementation: Evaluated on 10 synthetic patients generated by a procedural composite model (Generator A). Held out generator test (Generator B) completed, showing MAE 39.45 vs 71.99 mg/dL persistence.
external_validity_and_generalizability.gap: Zero real-world human data (DiaTrend, OhioT1DM) has been processed. The model's real-world clinical performance remains entirely unproven.
external_validity_and_generalizability.required_remediation: Explicitly disclose that all claims of error reduction apply strictly to the specified in silico data-generating process, not human subjects.

counterfactual_and_intervention_simulati.current_implementation: Unvalidated formulas for exercise and meal carb sensitivity discussed in concept.
counterfactual_and_intervention_simulati.gap: No causal evidence or validated pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) backing for medication or exercise interventions.
counterfactual_and_intervention_simulati.required_remediation: Strictly label all counterfactual/scenario tools as an unvalidated exploratory sandbox, or disable them from clinical claims.

tier_1_experimentally_validated: Autoregressive CGM 120-min point forecasting on synthetic cohort (HistGradientBoosting: 18.69 mg/dL MAE vs 53.25 mg/dL persistence)
Strict chronological train/val/test splitting with 120-min buffer
Ablation of lag window depth, summary statistics, rate-of-change, and diurnal sin/cos harmonics
Regime-stratified error analysis (fast rising, fast falling, in-range, nocturnal)
Per-patient error variability across 10 synthetic subjects
Input integrity gating (freshness, gap detection, bounds checking)
tier_2_implemented_unvalidated: Replay scenario injector (ReplayEngine) for sensor fault simulation
Local fallback execution engine in Streamlit
tier_3_ui_presentation_only: Static patient profile display (demographics, clinical notes in sidebar)
Reliability indicator badge and traffic light UI
Personalization toggle for SYNTH_002 (hardcoded -7.17 mg/dL bias shift)
tier_4_hypothesis_simulation_sandbox: Counterfactual exercise effect on glucose clearance
Causal attribution claims via SHAP / feature importances

forbidden_claims: GlucoTwin is a clinically validated medical device or diagnostic system
GlucoTwin reduces forecast error on human diabetes patients by 64.9%
The model provides actionable insulin dosing, medication adjustment, or meal therapy advice
Feature importance or SHAP scores prove causal physiological drivers of glucose excursions
Simulated exercise or drug effects represent true biological outcomes in real patients
The system maintains a full-body biophysical digital twin of the patient
open_research_questions: Q1: Does fusing static patient EHR context with dynamic CGM stream produce a statistically significant reduction in forecast error over CGM-only models?
Q2: Can we formulate a mathematically rigorous metric for Twin Drift that separates sensor failure from physiological state divergence?
Q3: Does selective prediction (abstention under high twin drift) improve downstream clinical utility and lower severe error rates?
Q4: How does performance translate from regression MAE to clinically actionable adverse event classification (Hypoglycemia < 70 mg/dL)?
contract_summary: The engineering foundation is robust and leakage-safe, but the scientific claims must be formally constrained. The project must pivot from a CGM-only regressor to a Two-Stream Twin Architecture with explicit Twin Drift Detection and Adverse Event scoring.
